parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO ai_intake_log (message_id, from_email, subject, source) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) = 1 AS claimed, (SELECT id FROM ins) AS log_id;
UPDATE ai_intake_log SET status = 'ignored', result = $2::jsonb WHERE message_id = $1;

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM service_zip_codes) AS configured, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_zip_codes WHERE zip = $1) AS in_area;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO conversations (type, dm_key, created_by) VALUES ('dm', $1, $2) ON CONFLICT (dm_key) WHERE type = 'dm' DO NOTHING;
SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE type = 'dm' AND dm_key = $1;
INSERT INTO conversation_members (conversation_id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $2), ($1, $3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, sender_id, body) SELECT $1, $2, $3 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = $4 AND ($5::boolean OR COALESCE((notification_preferences->>'automation_dms')::boolean, true) = true));

parameters.query:
WITH esc AS (
  UPDATE tickets t SET escalated_at = now()
  WHERE t.source = 'ai_intake' AND t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status = 'open' AND t.first_response_at IS NULL AND t.escalated_at IS NULL
    AND t.is_archived = false AND t.created_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' AND t.created_at > now() - interval '12 hours'
  RETURNING t.id, t.subject, t.assigned_user
)
SELECT esc.id AS ticket_id, esc.subject, r.uid AS recipient_id
FROM esc CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT esc.assigned_user AS uid WHERE esc.assigned_user IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' AND active = true
) r WHERE r.uid <> 9;
